We are looking for a skilled and self‑driven Hardware Engineer with 2+ years of hands‑on experience in IoT, embedded systems, and hardware product development. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting hardware solutions that integrate seamlessly with mobile applications and cloud platforms.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • End‑to‑End Hardware Development: Design, develop, prototype, and validate IoT hardware products from requirements analysis and component selection through testing and production readiness.
  • Firmware Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize embedded firmware for microcontrollers, ensuring stable operation, efficient resource utilization, and reliable hardware interaction.
  • Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth Integration: Implement wireless connectivity, device discovery, BLE pairing, Wi‑Fi provisioning, network configuration, reconnection handling, and secure communication between devices and applications.
  • Mobile App‑Based Relay Control: Develop and integrate relay control functionality allowing users to switch devices via a mobile app, with status feedback, command validation, and fail‑safe behavior.
  • OTA Update Implementation: Design and maintain reliable OTA firmware update mechanisms, including secure delivery, version control, integrity verification, rollback support, and recovery procedures.
  • Circuit Design and Hardware Integration: Prepare schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and prototypes; integrate sensors, relays, power supplies, communication modules, and other components.
  • Testing, Debugging, and Reliability: Identify and resolve hardware, firmware, connectivity, and integration issues; conduct functional, stress, power‑consumption, and reliability testing.
  • Independent Execution and Documentation: Work independently with minimal supervision, coordinate with mobile and backend developers as needed, and maintain clear technical documentation, test reports, BOMs, and manufacturing‑ready design files.

Preferred Skills

  • Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers: Experience with ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, or similar, including peripheral interfacing and system architecture.
  • Embedded Firmware Development: Proficiency in C/C++ and debugging/optimizing firmware for real‑world products.
  • Wireless Connectivity: Practical experience with Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth/BLE, device pairing, network provisioning, reconnection logic, and reliable communication.
  • OTA Firmware Updates: Experience implementing secure OTA updates, version management, validation, rollback, and recovery.
  • Relay & Electrical Control Systems: Designing and integrating relay‑based switching, GPIO controls, optocouplers, MOSFETs, and driver circuits.
  • Circuit Design & PCB Development: Proficiency in schematic design, PCB layout, component selection, prototyping, using tools such as KiCad, Altium Designer, or equivalents.
  • IoT & Mobile/Cloud Integration: Integrating devices with mobile apps and cloud backends via MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, WebSockets, etc.
  • Hardware Debugging & Testing: Strong troubleshooting using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, serial debugging tools, and related techniques.

How to Apply

If you are passionate about IoT product development and can independently take an embedded hardware solution from concept to a working product, please email your updated CV to careers@spericorn.com with the subject line “Hardware Engineer”.
